### Camden Property Trust Announces Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Release and Conference Call Dates


10/7/2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s28.q4cdn.com/425223795/files/doc_news/Camden-Property-Trust-Announces-Third-Quarter-2026-Earnings-Release-and-Conference-Call-Dates-2026.pdf)


HOUSTON--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Camden Property Trust (NYSE:CPT) (the “Company”) announced today that its third quarter 2026 earnings will be released after the market closes on Thursday, November 5, 2026. The Company will host a conference call on Friday, November 6, 2026, at 10:00 AM Central Time, which will include prepared remarks by management and a question-and-answer session. Camden’s complete earnings release and supplemental data will be available in the Investors section of the Company’s website at[https://investors.camdenliving.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.camdenliving.com&esheet=54617895&newsitemid=20261007462458&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.camdenliving.com&index=1&md5=bad3f281038bde7d9399573767fc6db4)


**Conference Call and Webcast Details** Domestic Dial-In Number: (888) 317-6003
International Dial-In Number: (412) 317-6061
Passcode: 1517857
Live Webcast:[https://investors.camdenliving.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.camdenliving.com&esheet=54617895&newsitemid=20261007462458&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.camdenliving.com&index=2&md5=ece24e5bcdf8ad0793d2204d10fb8678)

Phone Replay Available through November 20, 2026
Webcast Replay:[https://investors.camdenliving.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.camdenliving.com&esheet=54617895&newsitemid=20261007462458&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.camdenliving.com&index=3&md5=864526cea1751e3da38590ebf1bc5d58)


Camden Property Trust, an S&P 500 Company, is a real estate company primarily engaged in the ownership, management, development, redevelopment, acquisition, and construction of multifamily apartment communities. Camden owns and operates 168 properties containing 56,995 apartment homes across the United States. Upon completion of 3 properties currently under development, the Company’s portfolio will increase to 58,157 apartment homes in 171 properties. Camden has been recognized as one of the 100 Best Companies to Work For® by FORTUNE magazine for 19 consecutive years, most recently ranking #13.


For additional information, please contact Camden’s Investor Relations Department at (713) 354-2787 or access our website at camdenliving.com.


Kim Callahan, 713-354-2549


Source: Camden Property Trust
